scope: Professor assignment compliance only, not conference acceptance readiness. Luna none retained. No new model or paid experiment.
conclusion: Core implementation and required experiment matrix are present and checked. Full assignment submission is incomplete: discourse interpretation must be finalized, paper/repository packaging and actual teammate reproduction/contributions remain.

items.requirement: MDP/POMDP specification, private-type boundary, bilateral acceptance, finite horizon and costs
Six Track C utterance functions with meaning-dependent transitions
items.detail: 396 generated/interpreted utterances; 180 semantic probes. Templates and cached execution are permitted by Track C section3.1 and common guide page8. Model agreement is not human gold accuracy.

items.requirement: Actual diplomatic sources, grouped split and at least 10 real-data environment cases
items.detail: 12 source contexts in 6 event groups; 24 type-specific validation paths. Numeric assumptions and generated trajectories explicitly synthetic.

items.requirement: Random, strong Heuristic, immediate-reward Bandit and PPO under common conditions
items.detail: All use the same frozen Luna execution module. Direct Luna and Sol are supplemental; planner cannot replace mandatory learned comparisons.

items.requirement: At least 3 base training seeds for Bandit and PPO
items.detail: Seeds17,29,43; 102400 interactions each; saved checkpoints and seed-level statistics.

items.requirement: Discount, entropy, major reward ablations; information/rule sensitivity
items.detail: Discount .8/.95/.99; entropy0/.01/.1; rejection/reversal cost omissions; belief and query interventions; question reliability, signal effect, feasibility, rejection/query cost sweeps. Single-seed supplementary runs disclosed as exploratory.

items.requirement: Metrics, losses, learning curves, transition counts/probabilities/heatmaps
At least 6 source-grounded discourse episodes with interpretation and comparisons
items.detail: 8 episodes/27 turns, 7 sy1 and 1 ir1; current selected policies are Heuristic, Planner and Direct_Luna. Walkthroughs give text/state/cost but mostly read as logs. Final submission should explain turning points and matched-policy alternatives, including learned-policy behavior; inspect conditional withdrawal and ratification speech-act errors.

items.requirement: Executable GitHub repository, data access, installation and reproduction instructions
items.detail: Code, model/runtime records and execution commands exist locally. No .git in current workspace; no final GitHub submission artifact verified. A portable dependency setup, included result/model files or access instructions, and source usage terms need final packaging.

items.requirement: Paper <=4 main-text pages plus Limitations and editable source
items.detail: paper directory contains acl.sty only. Actual conference submission or acceptance is not required by the class guide page22.

items.requirement: Another team member executes declared reproduction and actual contributions recorded
items.detail: Saved-model replay in a new Python process is completed but is not another-member reproduction. Common guide pages21/24 and Track C Task14 explicitly require it.
